newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best downgrades Blue Cross of Washington.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best downgrades Blue Cross of Washington.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said on Monday that it has lowered its rating on Blue Cross of Washington & Alaska in Mountlake Terrace, Washington from "A-" to "B++."

A.M. Best attributed the move to poor earnings performance in 1995 and 1996 and challenges the company faces in shifting its enrollment base to managed-care products and adjusting to health-care reform in Washington State.

"Although results in 1996 were poor, the company has taken steps to improve its results in 1997, including recontracting of provider networks and tighter underwriting practices," A.M. Best said in a release.

It said the company's concentration in individual products make it particularly vulnerable to regulatory constraints, but said rate increases approved last week may signal a change in the previously adversarial regulatory environment. "This should also have a positive impact on future earnings," A.M. Best said.
